title: Relativistic kinetic energy
references: Rindler, W., Relativity: Special, General, and Cosmological, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press (2006)
Taylor, E. F. and Wheeler, J. A., Spacetime Physics, 2nd ed., W. H. Freeman (1992)
validity_domain: Kinetic energy (gamma - 1) m c^2 of a body of non-zero rest mass m at speed v < c in an inertial frame.
limitations: Kinetic energy only: the rest energy m c^2 is not included
Free body in an inertial frame; rotation and internal energy are not included
The 0.5 % tolerance covers the rounding of a stated figure, it is not a physical uncertainty
